overview: Ali steals and posts the stolen items on social media to support his mother in his crime-ridden neighborhood. Meanwhile, Mahir, the neighborhood's big brother who's just been released from prison, has something to hide...
title: Altın Çocuk

overview: Derin is 27 years old. Her father died. It may seem normal to you because that's what happens to dads over time. They are dying. Derin falls in love the day her father died and writes a book about it, hard to believe, but Derin is a writer. Derin has to deal with the loss of her father while writing a book.
title: Ben Bu Boşluğu Nasıl

overview: Guan Mengmeng, a Chinese girl with e-commerce dreams, traveled to the Kingdom of Mambo only to have her ambitions shattered by a boyfriend's betrayal. A twist of fate led her into a "contract marriage" with Crown Prince Song Pai, who was grappling with a succession crisis. Seizing this opportunity, Guan Mengmeng restarted her career in the royal court with modern e-commerce thinking, unaware that Song Pai had already begun to secretly admire her. As they joined hands to promote goods from both countries, the pair fought against the traditional forces led by the second prince and uncovered numerous conspiracies. Bound by a century-old karmic fate linked to a snake-shaped pendant, their fake relationship blossomed into genuine love while they fought side by side. In the end, they achieved success in both business and true love.
title: Manbo Destiny

overview: Jasmine Harman and a team of property experts help British couples find homes for to avoid the cold winter, as they head to hotter destinations around the world.
title: A Place in the Sun: Winter Sun

overview: Police seek help from imprisoned serial killer to catch a copycat murderer mimicking her methods.
title: Mrs. Deshpande

overview: The F Ward is about brilliant, flawed interns whose careers are on life support. Sent to the under-funded Pines Hospital in Sydney for a final chance, they must overcome their insecurities, their past and their own expectations, in a hot house environment where the stakes are life and death.
title: The F Ward

overview: The series follows Gloria Trevi during her global "Mi Soundtrack" tour, offering an intimate portrait of her life both on and off stage. From personal moments at home with her family to performances before thousands of fans, La Trevi: Sin Filtro promises to show the artist as she truly is raw, authentic, and uncensored. "My life and career have always been in the public eye but often told through the lens of others. even by people who don't even know me! This series is a window into who I am today on tour, at home, with my family, doing what I love, and embracing everything around me… from the chaos and legal matters I can share, to the joy that fuels my music and my life. It's raw, it's real, but it's me: without a filter," said Gloria Trevi. With over 30 million albums sold, Trevi is one of the most successful and controversial artists in Latin music. A constantly evolving pop icon, her career has been marked by hit songs, public scandals, and a continuous process of reinvention.
title: La Trevi: Sin Filtro

overview: The 30th Birthday Championship was a special mini-series of the British television game show Countdown, produced to mark the programme's 30 years on air. It brought together 41 former contestants from different eras of Countdown, including many well-known and highly regarded players from the first three decades of the programme. Its overall purpose was to showcase standout competitors from across the years and to identify the strongest performer among them. The competition was structured as a staged tournament, beginning with preliminary rounds before progressing into a knock-out format. In addition to its commemorative focus, the mini-series also marked a change behind the scenes, as some episodes were recorded in a new studio location, reflecting a transitional moment in the show's production history.
title: Countdown 30th Birthday Championship

overview: When 20-something Yusuf is arrested for a series of bank heists, his sister attempts to return the money and identify who betrayed him.
title: Banksters

overview: Eric Jerome Dickey's Friends and Lovers is a contemporary romantic drama exploring how friendship, passion, and forgiveness collide. The story follows two best friends, Debra, a Type A doctor, and Shelby, a free-spirited rule breaker, as their lives intertwine with those of Leonard, a rising but struggling comedian, and Tyrese, his loyal best friend. As Debra and Leonard's love deepens, and Tyrese finds himself entangled with Shelby's unpredictable ways, the four navigate the challenges of modern relationships. When tragedy strikes the group, they are forced to rebuild—transforming their bond from friendship into chosen family.
title: Eric Jerome Dickey's Friends and Lovers

overview: The Site is an hour-long television program devoted to the Internet revolution.
title: The Site

overview: The Haunted is a chilling and frightening show featuring true horror stories about animals, humans and the paranormal. Each program features one or two stories recounted by the people who actually experienced them. Cinematic recreations serve to heighten the drama caused by animal and human contact with the unexplainable and to bring the witnesses' testimonies to life.
title: The Haunted

overview: A series which explores the most extraordinary weather occurences that have happened around the world.
title: The World's Weirdest Weather

overview: Angelica sends Chise some magic supplies including a present. The present turns out to be a book Chise read in her childhood. Elias asks Chise to tell him the story behind the book. Chise tells him about Miura-san and the mysterious library she found in the forest as a child. The story takes place during episode 13 of Mahoutsukai no Yome TV anime.
title: Mahoutsukai no Yome: Hoshi Matsu Hito

overview: As the television anime Mahoutsukai no Yome debuts a new episode every week, one new 30-second episode of the series of shorts will debut every week on the official Twitter every Tuesday. The previous week's episode will no longer be available when each new episode debuts.
title: MahoYome

overview: Writer Aglaya Ermolaeva accidentally knocks down her literature teacher Alexander Sergeevich Smirnov, whom she was madly in love with at school. The teacher was miraculously unharmed, but it turns out that he became a victim of fraud, lost his apartment and now has nowhere to live. His son Mitya soon becomes homeless too — his wife expels him from the house and changes the locks. Aglaya decides to shelter both men in her apartment and organizes a so-called "Rescue Committee" consisting of Smirnov's former students. She's going to expose the scammers and restore justice, but she underestimates the danger hanging over her.
title: Комитет спасения

overview: The marriage of Elena and Mikhail Orlov seems indestructible. A home, a job I love, an adult daughter. But Elena is a workaholic doctor and she doesn't have time for a family at all. The husband has always been understanding about this, but his patience is already running out, because his wife is never around. In addition, Elena does not want to have a child and increasingly disappears in an orphanage. She hopes to adopt a girl whose mother died on her operating table. But the husband is categorically against it. When Elena forgets about the wedding anniversary, an upset Mikhail finds himself in the arms of his secretary. He even decides to leave his wife, but does not suspect that in fact everything is not at all as it seems to him.…
title: Идеальный брак

overview: After experiencing a difficult divorce from her husband, Elena Troyanskaya comes from St. Petersburg to her native Rechnogorsk. She is not ready for a new relationship, the main thing for her now is to complete the order for the improvement of the city park on time. So far, there have been two gardening companies in the city owned by friends, Dronov and Vasilkov. And now, fearing that Elena will compete with them, they decide to force her to abandon the project. To do this, they hire a "professional wrecker," a "specialist in ruining companies." He undertakes to fulfill the order, and troubles begin to fall on Lena one by one.…
title: Розы и шипы

overview: After a night out together, casual acquaintances Anya and Sergey don't know how to behave properly.… Should I call or wait? Does the partner want to continue? And is the feeling suddenly mutual? Doubts prevent them from meeting. And there are friends and acquaintances around with their confusing personal stories and unnecessary advice.
title: Свидание вслепую

overview: Marina Svetlova's life is not going well on all fronts. The woman is already over forty, and she lives with her mother, barely makes ends meet, and there is no gap on the horizon. When Marina unexpectedly inherits a summer cottage from a deceased relative, it seems like a lucky chance, but then fate deceives her. Instead of a fashionable country house, Marina is greeted by an old ruin. But, contrary to the obvious, all the most interesting things for Marina are just beginning. A random passerby predicts to Marina that the cottage will change the fate of the owner. What is hidden behind this prophecy?
title: Старая развалина

overview: Sonya, a teacher from the city of Mosinsk, unexpectedly wins fifteen million in the lottery. Anyone would be happy to win, but Sonya is embarrassed in front of her colleagues. She is already thinking about giving up the money, but her daughter Lena, mother Antonina Vasilyevna and ex-husband Sergei are already going to go with her to Moscow to collect the winnings. Sonya decides to use this situation to tell on television about the destruction of a historical monument in her hometown – the house of merchant Zhurov. Sonya embarks on a journey with her mother, daughter, ex-husband Sergei, and former classmate and now successful Moscow journalist Viktor, who has been in love with her since high school. But the heroes can't even imagine what kind of adventure they're going to have.
title: Миллионерша

overview: Britain is home to the most extraordinary annual folk rituals and seasonal customs. This unique documentary series takes you deep inside these living traditions, capturing how they are prepared, performed and passed down through time.
title: Gatherings
Русские народные. Вся правда о сказках

overview: Historical western series about the oil boom in the Lüneburg Heath around 1900: The young farmer's daughter Johanna Lambert works as a maid to support her family. Nobody suspects that there is a treasure hidden beneath the Lambert family's forest: oil. Only Richard, the son of the neighbouring farmer Wilhelm Pape, knows about it and dreams of a future together with Johanna. Their forbidden love is put to the test when unscrupulous oil trader Tyler Robertson appears and a bitter battle for power and wealth begins. Wilhelm Pape, driven by greed, does not shy away from any means: betrayal, fraud and the expropriation of the Lamberts drive the village to the edge of the abyss. After the mysterious death of her father, Johanna has to sell the family forest - a momentous step because Wilhelm immediately starts extracting oil there. But Johanna doesn't give up. With unshakable courage, she opposes Wilhelm's intrigues and unites the farmers against his thirst for power. In the midst of violence and hopelessness, Johanna searches for justice and fights for her true love - and for the survival of her village.
title: Schwarzes Gold

overview: Verdict with Dan Abrams looks at the day's news from a legal viewpoint, featuring Abrams' perspective as he assesses right from wrong and determines the winners and losers in politics, law and pop culture.
title: Verdict with Dan Abrams

overview: Time and Again was a nostalgic, retrospective show on MSNBC, hosted by Jane Pauley, that revisited classic TV moments and interviews from NBC's history, airing around the late 1990s and early 2000s, showcasing the connection between the two networks as MSNBC evolved from NBC's cable news venture.
title: Time and Again

overview: Posh Pawnbrokers, a spin-off from the makers of Posh Pawn, follows a number of high-end, characterful pawn-brokers from across the UK. Sometimes weird and often wonderful, every item that comes through their doors has a story. But it's not only the items that have interesting backgrounds; the owners are full of charisma too! The series will unearth everything from high-value family heirlooms, stunning jewellery and flash cars, to curious collectables, unique antiques and bizarre memorabilia from all over the world. Some of these pieces are worth life changing sums of money.
title: Posh Pawnbrokers

overview: Frans and Mariska Bauer have been a well-oiled machine for over 30 years. Frans travels throughout the country for his performances and is often away from home. Mariska runs the house. Now that their boys are getting older and increasingly independent, they can't escape the fact that this busy life will be very different in a few years. Empty nest syndrome is looming. Besides, Frans saw Abraham last year and finds balance in his busy career increasingly important. But how do you achieve that? In "Frans & Mariska, Couples on the Test," they prepare for this new phase in their lives. They put it to the test and ask themselves: is overwintering in Spain something for us? They get help from other well-known couples who, like them, have the same question or have already found the answer.
title: Frans & Mariska: Stellen op de Proef

overview: Veteran journalist Barbara Walters interviews a variety of entertainers, politicians, athletes and other public figures.
title: The Barbara Walters Specials

overview: Valentina López is a young and beautiful professional boxer nicknamed "La Monita". From a young age, she has learned to overcome adversity through courage and hard work after her mother abandoned her and Doña Nieves took her in, along with Beto, her longtime boyfriend and trainer. After injuring her hand in a fight, Valentina has to find a job while she recovers, never imagining that becoming the secretary of Mauricio Sermeño, a former race car driver and owner of the real estate company Grupo Sermeño, would lead her to find love. However, nothing will be easy for Valentina and Mauricio, as they are pursued by his fiancée, Constanza, and his villainous cousin, Jerónimo.
title: Un gancho al corazón

overview: Lara and Martim are from different worlds, but when they meet, they fall madly in love with each other. Lara is a kickboxer and Martim is a successful businessman, owner of a large economic group linked to the IT sector. Besides computers, Martim loves cars and racing. A former Super Touring champion, he stopped racing on the tracks, but lives life at high speed. Martim has been a widower for five years. Tragedy entered his life when he least expected it, when his wife died in a car accident. Martim was never the same again. Until Lara enters his life, like a hurricane.
title: Deixa-me Amar

overview: MSNBC at the Movies was a show from the mid-2000s, hosted by Sharon Tay, that covered the film industry with star/director interviews, behind-the-scenes info, and critic reviews, focusing on movie premieres and DVD releases .
title: MSNBC at the Movies

overview: Learn how to play better from the finest players to ever play the game. Their goal is to teach you the skills and strategies that helped them do it. Like Golf Channel Academy on Facebook, follow @GCA on Twitter and tweet using #GCAcademy. Want a hands-on, personalized instructional lesson? Visit GolfChannelAcademy.com to find a local Golf Channel Academy near you.
title: Golf Channel Academy

overview: As a result of an accident, Lyudmila's son Vladimir dies. Before he dies, he tells her that he has an illegitimate son. He wants to leave all his possessions to him. The dying man has always had a difficult, conflicted relationship with his mother. He doubts that she will comply with his request and begs: "Do not deceive ..." Lyudmila begins searching for her son's ex-girlfriend and her grandson, and during this time, meeting different people from her son's entourage, she rethinks her relationship with him.
title: Не обмани

overview: Lida is so in love with the young scientist Igor that she is ready to do anything for his happiness. Even to take out a loan secured by his apartment for the sake of his postgraduate studies. Igor moves to Moscow and invites Lida with him, she drops everything and goes with him. But in the capital, Igor looked for a more profitable match - the rector's daughter, and left Lida the day she found out she was pregnant. Hard times are beginning for Lida. She takes on any job, and fate brings her to the home of spouses Anna Arkadyevna and Vadim Yurievich. Lida gets a job as their housekeeper, and Vadim begins to show her signs of attention, which she is ready to reciprocate.…
title: Любить

overview: Dana Kovaleva is the director of the advertising department of a fashion company. Suddenly, she begins to receive attentions from her charming boss, Roman Savelov. True, the boss is married, but he claims that his marriage is formal: his wife is much older than him, has been living in Europe for a long time, and is also ill. Dana falls in love, and meanwhile her career is rapidly going "uphill." In a short period of time, she becomes the executive and then the CEO of the company. But just as quickly, the girl finds herself... in the dock.…
title: Ошибка

overview: A young, simple-minded driver, Fedor, who has long been known as Fedyunchik, periodically earns money by illegal transportation. Because of them, he often becomes a hostage to dramatic situations. One day, the hero picks up Kostya, a teenager who ran away from an orphanage, on the highway. Kostya admits that he has a mother whom he has been planning to see for a long time. Fyodor agrees to take him to his mother, not anticipating how this road will turn out for both of them.…
title: Дальнобойщик

overview: A young man named Anton, a former special forces soldier and now a bank employee, suddenly finds out that his promotion is the result of his wife's affair with the bank's director. After learning about this, Anton leaves his wife and gets a job as a ski instructor.
title: Стая

overview: In the mid-Ming Dynasty, the old emperor (actually Emperor Xianzong Zhu Jianshen, played by Song Yuncheng) was in a coma, and the matter of establishing an heir was unresolved. Crown Prince Zhu Youcheng (later appointed as the heir apparent and succeeded Emperor Xianzong after his death, played by Wang Defeng) and "Prince Qi" Zhu Jianyi coveted the throne and engaged in open and covert struggles. At this time, a series of murders broke out in the capital. The court ordered the Six Doors (a government agency in Beijing) to handle the case. Shen Ziming, the head of the Six Doors (Six Gates), initially wanted to smooth things over, but actually did not want his son Shen Lixing to be involved in the court intrigue. Therefore, he tried every means to prevent his son from entering the Six Doors. However, Shen Lixing could not bear to let the truth be buried, and with his extraordinary talent, he quickly solved the case by dissecting the mystery. But after solving the case, he was drawn into an even greater power struggle, thus setting the stage for a court intrigue.
title: The Six Gates

overview: The Captive's War follows a group of prisoners who rise from the ashes of catastrophe to destroy their conqueror's society from within. It is an epic tale about the transformative power of individuality in a totalitarian world.
title: The Captive's War

overview: Connected: Coast to Coast will include informed, topical debate on topics from politics to pop culture, with an emphasis on the latest news and buzz in the online community. Crowley will host from MSNBC headquarters in New Jersey, while Reagan hosts from MSNBC.com headquarters in Redmond, Washington—connecting across the U.S. and connecting cable television and the Internet in a wholly unique telecast. The two telecasts of "Connected: Coast to Coast" present two different takes on the day's news. The first hour of "Connected," 12-1 p.m. (ET), will examine the news of the day as it develops, with analysis and debate. The second hour, 5-6 p.m. (ET) will take a fresh look at the day's events, incorporating viewers' questions and issues into the debate. "Connected" will respond directly to viewers' comments and questions, and provide the experts and analysis to help viewers get the questions they ask answered.
title: Connected: Coast to Coast

overview: A young woman who supports her mother and sister after the death of their father, To sustain their daily needs she earns a living as a tricycle driver.
title: Coffee Prince

overview: When Andrea Yates drowned her five children in the family bathtub one June morning in 2001, the world was left shocked – what could make a young mother do something like that to her own children? In the wake of her confession, it was established Yates was suffering from postpartum depression and psychosis. But while understanding of her mental illness helped illuminate Andrea's struggle prior to the incident, now 25 years later, ID unravels the deeply tangled layers in which a cult can influence vulnerable individuals through manipulation and control by offering unprecedented insight into Michael Woroniecki, a rogue street preacher turned cult leader, and his connection to Andrea Yates.
title: The Cult Behind the Killer: The Andrea Yates Story

overview: Texas Ranger James Holland doesn't play by the rules. He's known as a serial killer whisperer because of his unique brand of interrogation tactics in cases once considered unsolvable. Watch as killers reveal the disturbing truth behind their crimes.
title: Killer Confessions: Case Files of a Texas Ranger

overview: After burying her mother, Irina leaves the God-forsaken provincial town for Moscow. In the capital, she meets a successful entrepreneur, George. They're having a wedding. Time passes, and Irina begins to realize that a cruel man is hiding under the mask of a loving and caring husband. Her husband is jealous of her for no reason, forbids her to communicate with old friends and even raises his hand against her...
title: Обет молчания

overview: Lonely and disappointed Tatiana Sergeevna Rakitina works at the registry office. Every day she sees happy newlyweds and... just gets annoyed. Tatiana herself has long since stopped enjoying her work and has become a routine. She sees the whole meaning of her life only in her son Dmitry. Tatiana takes great care of him, indicating what to do and who to date, completely forgetting that the "boy" has already grown up. One day Dmitry confronts his mother with the fact that he intends to get married. This news ruins Tatiana's whole world. She declares a real war on potential daughter-in-law Dasha. In the end, the main character manages to break up the lovers. But this does not make Dmitry happy at all. Moreover, Tatiana's thoughtless actions lead to her son being hospitalized. Now Tatiana has to correct her mistakes and reconcile the "children" again. She successfully copes with this difficult task, and at the same time gets her own "little feminine happiness", which she no longer hoped for.
title: Мама, я женюсь!

overview: A murder in Bucharest opens the door to a much bigger mystery than it seems. Edi, a police inspector, discovers that the answers are not only in the files, but also in signs that no one else sees.
title: Cei trimisi

overview: The Golf Fix is an instructional series, hosted by golf pro Michael Breed who tackles viewer questions, demonstrates useful drills and takes a look at some of the most exciting shots from the previous weekend's professional tournaments.
title: The Golf Fix

overview: Haydar Ali after avenging his family's murder, ends up in prison. There, he finds himself in the middle of one of Türkiye's most dangerous underground cartels. However, the truly deadly confrontation begins three years later, when he regains his freedom and learns that the woman whom he has never been able to forget, is now the wife of the man closest to him.
title: Yeraltı

overview: Mammoth's Mike Bubbins and celebrity friends are making a list (and checking it twice) of Christmas crackers. What are their all time festive favourites from TV, film and music?
title: Christmas Top 5
Три друга, клад и матрос Кошка
The Cross Connection with Tiffany Cross

overview: Wogan's Perfect Recall is a British quiz show hosted by Terry Wogan in which contestants test both their general knowledge and their memory. As the game progresses, answers given earlier return to challenge players later, rewarding those who can recall information under pressure. The last contestant standing faces a high-stakes final for the chance to win a substantial cash prize.
title: Wogan's Perfect Recall

overview: The small town of Terlingua, Texas is a little known oasis on the Rio Grande River where eccentric residents trade modern comforts for a unique brand of freedom. But the price of their freedom proves high when a brutal crime threatens to tear their town apart. This true-crime docu-series delves into the eccentric world of Terlingua as its citizens struggle to reconcile the killing of a dear friend and fight to hold the town together as it grapples with change.
title: Badlands, Texas

overview: The tragic story of Yalenis, a young Cuban woman trapped in a toxic relationship with a Galician businessman. Her desire for independence triggers a series of events that lead to her and an unknown young man's double murder. Through a police investigation and revealing testimonies, the series unveils the depths to which obsession and power can drive people.
title: Crimen por encargo

overview: A two-part miniseries about the murder of Ingrid Visser and her partner in Murcia. The pregnant volleyball player traveled with Severein for personal and financial reasons. Both were brutally murdered and buried in a lemon grove. The investigation revealed debts and shady dealings linked to a volleyball club.
title: Missing in Murcia

overview: Eymen Studios imzalı, 2026 yılında EXXEN'de yayınlanacak olan "Dünyada Neler Oluyor?" adlı belgesel programı...
title: Dünyada Neler Oluyor?
The Big Idea with Donny Deutsch

overview: A drama depicting a life-threatening confrontation between a woman who takes another person's life for revenge and a woman who takes another person's life for her own desires.
title: The First Man

overview: In HNM, the podcast, Hélène Hendriks, Noa Vahle, and Merel Ek bring together the best of television, sports, and politics in an open conversation.
title: HNM De Podcast

overview: All the latest breaking news with the Virgin Media News team.
title: Virgin Media News Update

overview: Analysis of the newly released classified state files.
title: Siar 20 Bliain

overview: Adapted from the American format Blackout, Take the Plunge featured two teams competing in a series of word-based challenges that combined description, deduction and strategic decision-making under time pressure. Hosted by Su Pollard and produced by Thames Television for ITV, the programme emphasised clarity of communication and tactical play, with success in the main game determining a team's opportunity to compete for the final prize.
title: Take the Plunge

overview: Why does Sweden look the way it does? Petra Mede, Gert Wingårdh and Mark Isitt take us on an entertaining journey through time about how our Swedish houses, homes and cities have developed, starting 100 years ago and looking 100 years into the future. Follow us to the private street, the big city, the industrial town, the country, the dream village, the suburbs, the city centre and the village!
title: Så byggdes Sverige

overview: Music Show where live acts performed and were interviewed
title: Music Japan

overview: Presumed dead for nearly twenty years, Flor reappears in Azores with a revelation capable of shaking the past and reshaping the present: her disappearance was not an accident, as everyone believed. The reunion with those who thought they had lost her forever, including a former love, reopens deep wounds and sets in motion a dangerous quest for justice.
title: Terra Forte

overview: The College Football Awards Nomination Special is where the nominees for all 24 of the yearly NCAA College Football Awards are announced.
title: College Football Awards Nomination Special

overview: SupermodelMe is a multi-platform reality series in which a number aspiring models of Asian heritage compete for a chance to launch their career in the fashion industry.
title: SupermodelMe

overview: Blackout saw two teams, each consisting of a contestant paired with a celebrity, compete to solve word puzzles. Each puzzle was a sentence or short paragraph with four missing words. One team member described a missing word while the contestant listened to the description afterward, but the opposing team could use a "blackout" button to mute parts of the clue to make guessing harder. Correctly guessed words earned money and a chance to solve the main puzzle. Winners advanced to a bonus round ("Clue Screen") where they had a limited time to guess up to five subjects from accumulating clues for a top prize.
title: Blackout
